messages:
maria: heads up — onboarding sampleapp: we flipped LOG_GATE to "info" in config service and started seeing request IDs drop on retries and logs losing debug lines in QA only. Anyone seen this pattern?
jonathan: hmm, did the OTEL hook order change? logging hook needs otel to populate MDC
lee: could also be the HTTP retry client stripping headers on redirect/retry. which http client lib are we using in sampleapp?
maria: sampleapp uses our internal http-retry middleware (net/http wrapper). repro: call /generate twice, first attempt shows req-id, on retry logs show no req-id. also debug messages missing because level is info now.
sam: paste minimal logs & env pls
maria: logs:
```
INFO  [sampleapp] server listening
DEBUG [sampleapp] req_id=xyz123 received /generate
DEBUG [sampleapp] retry attempt=1 outgoing headers: x-request-id missing
INFO  [sampleapp] generation complete tokens=38
```
env: LOG_GATE=info, SDK_HOOKS_ORDER="auth,otel,logging"
jonathan: aha — hook order `auth,otel,logging` should be fine if otel runs before logging. but your sdk shows otel before logging? the string says otel then logging though. odd.
lee: wait — earlier we shipped a change that shifts "filter" hook earlier to apply gating before logging. if filter runs before logging it strips context since we short-circuit some enrichers. default got mutated in config service last week.
maria: repro notes: set SDK_HOOKS_ORDER=otel,logging,filter and keep LOG_GATE=info — req-id is preserved on retry and debug messages are still gated at format layer. so fix seems to be run otel first, then logging, then filter.
sam: short-term we can enforce an override for the sampleapp via SDK_HOOKS_OVERRIDE env while we patch config service. long-term we should add a startup sanity check that warns if logging precedes otel.
jonathan: agreed — I'll open a tiny PR: 1) startup validator that errors or logs WARN if `logging` appears before `otel`; 2) unit test simulating a retry preserving x-request-id; 3) add note in onboarding docs about hook ordering.
lee: alternative mitigation: enrich outgoing retry request with existing req-id in middleware so header doesn't vanish on retry. useful for older clients.
devex-bot: Reminder: If you change default values in config service, add a changelog and notify operations.
maria: thanks — @sam can you push the override branch and PR? I'll add the repro harness and the exact config values to the sampleapp repo. also agree to add a small integration test in CI that runs sampleapp with LOG_GATE=info to catch the regression before rollout. :thumbsup:
